LESSON 08 / 27 • ORIGINAL CHECKLIST
Labels, name and value
A label provides an accessible name; name identifies a submitted field; value supplies its
label එක input එක හඳුනාගන්න උදව් කරනවා. name එක server එකට යන key එක. value එක
1 label for →input id · 2 name →delivery · 3 value →express · 4 request →delivery=express
Read the numbered stages from top to bottom. label for → input id; request → delivery=express.

<label for="express">Express delivery</label>
<input id="express" type="radio" name="delivery" value="express">
<label for="normal">Normal delivery</label>
<input id="normal" type="radio" name="delivery" value="normal">
Expected result: Selecting Express submits delivery=express if the form is submitted.
Interview question: Why do radio buttons share a name?
Answer: A shared name groups radio buttons so only one is selected in that group.
Practice: Create a labeled payment-method radio group.
